about_the_game:
Blood Moon Horror


Blood Moon Horror is a heart-stopping 1–8 player co-op survival horror set in a quarantined lunar research facility—where the blood moon awakens something that hunts in the dark. No weapons. No combat. Only stealth, teamwork, and terror.


You are a rescue team sent to Lunar Base Alpha after three months of silence. The base has become a tomb: intelligent, adaptive extraterrestrial entities stalk the corridors, manipulate ventilation and power, and some even mimic human voices. Work with friends (or strangers) and use nothing but your wits to survive—because every sound could be your last.


About the Game


The year is 2078. What began as humanity’s most ambitious lunar research program has spiraled into an experiment gone horribly wrong. The last transmission from Lunar Base Alpha cut off mid-sentence: "The moon... it's changing. The samples... they're alive. We can't contain—"* [TRANSMISSION ENDED]


Now you’re inside. The life systems are failing. The entities hunt by sound and electricity, slip through vents, and learn from you. Your mission: survive, uncover the truth, restore power, and escape before the blood moon finishes its work.


Key Features


  • 1–8 Player Co-op Survival Horror – Real teamwork matters. Share objectives, coordinate puzzles, and make split-second decisions with friends or public matches. Solo? You can try — but the game is built around cooperation.

  • Proximity Voice Chat & Spatial Audio – Hear teammates (and impostors) as they would sound in the world. Whisper to coordinate or listen for distress through the vents—voice is both tool and risk.

  • No Combat — Pure Survival – There are no guns or forced combat mechanics. Evade, hide, and outsmart predators who react to sound, light, and electrical noise.

  • Advanced Enemy AI – Extraterrestrial hunters with dynamic behaviors: patrols, vent navigation, sound investigation, and voice mimicry. They adapt to your tactics and punish predictable play.

  • Electrical Switch Box Puzzles – Team-oriented puzzles that require timing and precise coordination. Fail, and you’ll attract something that hunts the sound of metal and sparks.

  • Document Collection & Environmental Storytelling – Piece together classified files, logs, and recordings to reveal the base’s tragic past and the origin of the infection.

  • Immersive Atmospherics – First-person perspective, adaptive lighting, and a reactive soundscape build relentless tension in the base’s claustrophobic halls.

  • Progression & Stats – Earn XP by completing objectives and puzzles. Track detailed stats and earn cosmetics to personalize your scientist.


Character Customization


Customize your survivor from multiple scientist variants and unlock skins as you progress. From lab coats to rare designer variants, stand out in the darkness—or try not to be noticed at all.

Gameplay Flow


  • Exploration Phase – Scavenge supplies and clues through a sprawling research facility while the blood moon rises above the base.

  • Survival Phase – Entities awaken and hunt. Move quietly, split tasks smartly, and use the environment to your advantage—sound is your enemy.

  • Investigation Phase – Solve electrical puzzles, restore systems, and collect documents that reveal the base’s experiments and moral collapse.

  • Escape Phase – Race failing life support and hostile intelligence to complete objectives and evacuate. Panic spreads fast—one mistake costs lives.


Development Roadmap


Blood Moon Horror is in active development — we ship regular updates, fixes, and content additions. Current status and upcoming features below.


  • ✅ Live Now: 1–8 player multiplayer, proximity voice chat, electric switch box puzzles, document collection, advanced enemy AI (one fully implemented predator with multiple archetypes), XP & progression, comprehensive stats, Steam integration.

  • 🔨 In Active Development: Fuse box & generator puzzles, two additional enemy types, shop system completion, expanded player customization, graphical upgrades, and performance optimizations.

  • 📋 Planned: Leaderboards, expanded cosmetics, new maps, story expansions, achievements, and a sanity mechanic that will alter perception and audio cues.


Content Warnings


Blood Moon Horror contains intense psychological horror: confined spaces, jump scares, disorienting audio, themes of isolation, and scenes designed to unsettle. Proximity voice chat may carry startling sounds. Not recommended for players who are sensitive to horror conventions.


Community & Development Commitment


We’re building this nightmare alongside our community. Expect regular updates, open communication, playtests, and developer posts. Follow us on Steam for patch notes, feature previews, and early access to new content. Add Blood Moon Horror to your wishlist to be notified of major updates and early access drops.


The base waits. The blood moon rises. How long can you survive?
